svg.title: v48 right-wingtip motion and the sagittal mirror control

cc:Work.dc:title: v48 right-wingtip motion and the sagittal mirror control
cc:Work.dc:description: 33 poses per wing. The recorded right path stays below the 19 mm normal approach needed to reach the mirrored wall.
